Agent Name: Planner
Step Number: 1
Reason for Mistake: Misinterpretation of Task Requirements regarding the nature of scientific research. The Planner incorrectly identified option C ("Why do people like to look at tulips?") as the best answer, arguing it is suitable for scientific research via surveys and neuroimaging. However, the core of the question asks which option could *best* be answered by scientific research in the context of objective, empirical discovery of natural phenomena. Option B ("What genes determine tulip petal color?") is the definitive scientific question involving genetics and biology, whereas Option C is a question of human psychology and sociology (subjective preference). The Planner confused the ability to *measure* subjective preference with the ability to *discover* an objective biological mechanism, failing to distinguish between empirical data collection on opinions versus scientific inquiry into natural laws.
